observations.why: Imperative directive with elevated absolutist phrasing ('everything about') keeps protocol distance — a formal register departure from the plainer second directive.
Flat instrumental imperative — no intensification, no elaboration — the matter-of-fact ground against which src-1's formality reads as departure.
